tests.initialFailure: The clock-controlled test expected 81 updates, but the existing batched deadline check completes 85. Its expected work count was corrected; the fresh-fit and prior-clearance tests passed on that first focused run.

visualReview.observation: The integrated resampled fit has smaller broad deformations and 1.35875% derived-mask disagreement, but the middle hearts still contain unwanted splits/channels and the border remains imperfect. Existing colour-retention checks do not certify faithful large enclosed motifs.

visualReview.scope: Every available prior/new photo render with different PNG bytes, including equal-error pairs; crop, binary target, previous and current weave from left to right.
findings: All twelve changed render pairs were inspected, including the equal-error leaf and puppy.
The Viking visibly regresses, with larger border distortions, seams and altered narrow motif detail. It also fails the paper/image checks; this is not dismissed as scoring noise.
Floral, warped and fine checkers retain curved or displaced cells and the defects already in their estimated masks; fine-checker error increases by 0.17875 percentage points.
The outline star remains rejected despite a low pixel error. The accepted leaf/maple-leaf and puppy retain their broad silhouettes but still show seams and imperfect boundaries.
Smaller mask errors are not asserted to imply uniformly better visual artwork.

limitations: Fresh deadline-bound controls vary: the same resampled baseline previously gave 7.439375%, while the new cold control gives 3.0375% and still fails paper. The exact 7.4% outcome is not presented as deterministic.
Independent geometry checks and a low total pixel error do not prove that all heart silhouettes are faithfully reconstructed.

The first full run loses the Viking acceptance (25/31 versus 26/31), with seven additional accepted-photo error increases. Its 22 Hunodan errors are unchanged. The narrower follow-up restores the focused Viking solve; its full corpus check is still pending.

componentReview.scope: Posthoc saved-export diagnostics. The 800px source is nearest-neighbour replication of the same 400px mask, not new image information. Stable enclosures are source-confidence heuristics, not artwork ground truth.
componentReview.interpretation: At both 400 and 800 pixels, the integrated output keeps 5 of 6 source-stable regions enclosed, up from 3 in the rejected resampled control. These six include two checker regions and four hearts. One heart remains open to the border, and another is split: its largest component retains only 67.2% (400px) / 67.0% (800px) of the source heart. The production fidelity check still passes. This is not complete motif recovery.

findings: The current learned mask has outer-edge transition counts [6,0,4,6], although the direct fitter estimates [3,3] from inset evidence. The corner-fragment helper has no proposal.

A uniform 1mm border interpretation restores [3,3,3,3] but changes 822/160000 pixels (0.51375%), just above the existing 0.5% topology-initialization allowance. A 0.75mm interpretation still misses two right-edge endpoints.

Combining already measured 0.5mm top/bottom/left interpretations with the 1mm right interpretation changes 740 pixels (0.4625%), restores [3,3,3,3] and retains every source feature and all six stable enclosures.

These side radii were selected after inspecting this case. No general selector, traced-curve error, new MILP result or template success is claimed. The input reference remains unchanged; the combined mask is only a possible initialization.
